comment: Myth definitions. 'domain' drives which terrain a region transmutes toward when this myth saturates. 'home' is the tradition that carries it. 'rootedness' (0-1) is how hard that tradition works to keep it alive: a deep-rooted myth survives without the player, a shallow one fades unless somebody deliberately retells it. Shallow myths are the interesting ones - they are the only reason to intervene. 'voice' carries the nouns each myth slots into the shared templates in voices.json.

myths.name: Greenmother
myths.blurb: She takes a finger for every good year.

voice.subject: Greenmother
voice.sign: a hand with a finger short
voice.verb: she takes a finger for a good year

myths.name: Hollowmaw
myths.blurb: The thin season given a mouth.

voice.subject: Hollowmaw
voice.sign: a bowl left out and licked clean

myths.name: Lantern Jack
myths.blurb: He walks the old drove road and he is counting.

voice.subject: Lantern Jack
voice.sign: a light that keeps pace with you

myths.name: The Bride in the Weir
myths.blurb: Only two people still know the second verse.

voice.subject: the Bride
voice.sign: a veil caught on the sluice

myths.name: The Drowned Bell
myths.blurb: It rings from under the water on the night someone is owed.

voice.subject: the Bell
voice.sign: a bell heard under the water
voice.verb: it rings when someone is owed

myths.name: Thirteen Steps
myths.blurb: Counted down into the fen, never back up.

voice.subject: the Steps
voice.sign: a thirteenth step that was not there
voice.verb: you count down and never back up

myths.name: Ash Mother
myths.blurb: What the fen remembers of the year it burned.

voice.subject: Ash Mother
voice.verb: she remembers the year it burned

myths.name: The Standing Man
myths.blurb: He was a boundary marker before he was a man.

voice.subject: the Standing Man
voice.sign: a stone that has moved overnight
voice.verb: he was a marker before he was a man

myths.name: The Emberwake
myths.blurb: A sleeper under the scree who turns over when wronged.

voice.subject: the Emberwake
voice.verb: he turns over when he is wronged

myths.name: The Counting Crow
myths.blurb: It lands on the roof of a house that will be empty by spring.

voice.subject: the Crow
voice.sign: a crow that stays too long
voice.verb: it counts the houses that will be empty
